content:
sam.dev: heads-up — since ~02:40 UTC we've seen intermittent RPC reconnects and 5xx from kv-sync on the inference pool. p99 went from ~40ms -> ~290ms, pod-to-pod retransmits spiking.

anya_sre: ack, can you paste a few logs and affected pods?

sam.dev: logs:
```
2026-03-16T02:41:03Z kv-sync[ee3f]: warn rpc: write failed: connection reset by peer
2026-03-16T02:41:03Z kv-sync[ee3f]: retrying (attempt 3)
2026-03-16T02:41:04Z kv-sync[eef1]: error rpc: timeout on write
```
Affected pods: inference-kv-7c9f6d8b4b-aaa, inference-kv-7c9f6d8b4b-bbb

mike_infra: possible overlay policy blocking outbound to pod CIDR. Any recent netpol changes?

sam.dev: there was a rollout of network policies last night from infra-team but not sure of the diff.

mike_infra: run `kubectl get networkpolicy -n inference -o yaml` and share. also `iptables -L -n` on one affected node might help.

sam.dev: pasted netpol output:
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-outbound
  namespace: inference
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          team: infra
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 12345
```

mike_infra: aha — namespaceSelector is targeting `team: infra` but inference pods live in namespaces labeled `team: ml`. That effectively denies most outbound from inference.

anya_sre: that would explain pod-to-pod RPC failures. Quick fix: add a specific allow-rule for the kv pods or fix the selector. Can we patch live?

sam.dev: applying hotfix now —
`kubectl apply -f - <<'YAML'`
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-inference-peer-egress
  namespace: inference
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      role: kv
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          role: kv
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 12345
`YAML`

deploy-bot: networkpolicy/allow-inference-peer-egress applied in inference (sha: hotfix-2038)

nora_ml: after apply, kv-sync retransmits dropped ~85% in the last 3m. Logs look much better. Still seeing occasional RDMA handshake timeouts on two nodes in az-west-2 though.

mike_infra: RDMA timeouts often point to MTU/encapsulation mismatch between host NIC and overlay. Check `ip link show` on host and `ip a` inside pods. Also `ethtool -k` and calico/vxlan MTU settings.

sam.dev: checked — host eth0 mtu=9000, calico/vxlan mtu=1450. We have host jumbo frames but overlay set low; that could fragment RDMA. I'll add an infra runbook entry and open a PR to harmonize MTU across nodes.

anya_sre: follow-ups: (1) commit netpol fix to infra repo PR, (2) add a unit test to CI that detects namespace-label mismatches for netpols targeting `inference`, (3) add an MTU check to our node health checks.

sam.dev: acknowledged. monitoring shows latencies back to baseline and error rates falling. Thanks all :thumbsup:

mike_infra: adding incident note and linking PR. Good catch.

sam.dev: :partyparrot:
